title: Publish chattic.us Next.js UI to AWS
description:
Definition of Done:
- chattic.us resolves to the production web distribution over HTTPS with a valid ACM certificate.
- Staging and development have named web origins (subdomains documented in SSM).
- The browser loads the UI and calls the thin-turn API at /api/* on the same origin (no separate api subdomain).
- Deploy is repeatable from GitHub Actions (OIDC) or documented manual cdk deploy; no Amplify, no CodePipeline.
- README What is live today reflects the web surface.

Architecture: Next.js on S3 behind CloudFront default behavior; /api/* behavior proxies to the thin-turn Lambda function URL with prefix strip. One distribution per environment owns the public hostname.
